activity_summary: Richard called from Holywell because he could not sleep. He asked for ten lines at the death, and you said no. He asked for six, and you told him the man was done with words. He asked what happens if the boy's voice goes in the vault. You told him she wakes hoarse, and that he should hold Nick as he did on Wednesday. The end stays five words. You did not say what the five words are.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the extra lines, and did not print the five words.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Called from Holywell, asked twice, and took the refusal.

facets.activity: Spoke in the glass with Burbage

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Will? Richard. From Holywell. I cannot sleep and I've woken the house trying.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thou hast had two hours of them, Dick. He's done with words. Drink, kiss her, fall.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Then she wakes hoarse, as a girl would that had slept two days in a grave. Hold him as thou didst Wednesday.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: God keep thee, then, thou flint.
